inputs.text: Restored high-definition still frame from a late-1990s Hong Kong music-video shoot, shot on 35mm film. Two male dancers hold a pose on an industrial rehearsal stage: on the right, a man in an oversized light beige blazer, dark blue trousers, white socks and black shoes, short slicked-back black hair and dark sunglasses, standing in a wide stance with both arms hanging loose; on the left, a darker-skinned man in a black sleeveless top, black trousers and black shoes, leaning forward with both arms raised in front of his chest, knees bent in a lunge, mid-motion. Behind them a metal scaffolding rig with vertical rails, a large circular louvered fan mounted high on the back wall, a hanging chrome pendant lamp, pale glowing rectangular floor panels laid across a concrete stage floor, tiny white light flecks drifting in the air. Cold cyan-blue stage lighting from above, deep shadows, faint haze in the air. Eye-level medium-wide shot, slight handheld tilt, both figures fully in frame. Photographic still, sharp focus, clean fine skin texture and visible fabric weave, crisp specular highlights on the metalwork, no video compression artifacts, no noise, no motion blur, high dynamic range, 4K scan of an original film negative. Two lines of white Chinese subtitle text with a dark outline at the lower left read "知己一聲拜拜" and "遠去這都市".
